07.words:
First thing on February 5th finds you at home.
Amy Cabrera has the story from South Barre Messenger about a price on carbon open, and keeps glancing back at it. // Amy Cabrera: What do you make of South Barre Messenger on a price on carbon? I can't tell if it's fair. [Replies: I saw it. They've got it about right. | I'm not sure that's the whole story, honestly. | I didn't see it. What did it say? | I haven't read it. Don't spoil it for me.] // Amy Cabrera: FIONA CABRERA
I saw it. They've got it about right.
Then what do we do about it? [Replies: All right, you're right. It bothers me too. | I read it twice. I still don't buy it. | I'm sorry. I can't get into this right now.] // Amy Cabrera: FIONA CABRERA
All right, you're right. It bothers me too.
So why isn't anyone doing anything about a price on carbon? We're the ones who live with it. [Replies: Yeah. I think it does matter. I just didn't want to say so. | I read it. I think they've got it backwards. | I'll think about it. I have to go.] // Amy Cabrera: FIONA CABRERA
Yeah. I think it does matter. I just didn't want to say so.
Does that mean you'd say something, if someone asked? [Replies: We can both read it and not agree. | Let me read it again before I say anything else.] // Amy Cabrera: FIONA CABRERA
We can both read it and not agree.
You think they got it wrong? I thought it was fair.
I'm going to keep bringing it up.

08.words:
Ivan Maldonado: First thing on January 23rd, you head to the City Clerk's office to pick up the papers for Selectboard member. Ivan Maldonado pulls them from a drawer. // Ivan Maldonado: How can I help you? [Replies: I want to run for Selectboard member. March 4, 2025 · Held by Tammy Wooten] // Ivan Maldonado: FIONA CABRERA
I want to run for Selectboard member.
So you're running for Selectboard member. There's no primary for this one, so you'd go straight onto the ballot March 4. The Barre Town Selectboard sets the budget and passes the local laws, and you'd get a vote on all of it. The papers are due back January 27.
You have to be 18 by election day. [Replies: Thanks.]
